      Problem: In the "Commit changes" step of the workflow-source repo path, the previous code incorrectly used `git rm -q` on files that were detected as deleted (missing from the working tree). `git rm -q` fails if the file is already gone from the filesystem. The fix correctly uses `git add -u` which stages the deletion of tracked files regardless of whether they exist on disk.
